answer_1.quote: We consider two tasks to evaluate off-the-shelf LLMs, including identifying ambiguities (cf. Section 5) and asking clarifying questions (cf. Section 6).

answer_2.quote: We utilize BertScore for automated assessment, as lexical matching metrics can not adequately capture clarification abilities.

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we also conduct human evaluation to score whether the generated question is helpful in resolving query ambiguity (denoted as Help.)
answer_4.guideline: assigning a binary score (0 or 1) to each generated question
